request.project_task: Build a personal data export request workflow.
request.project_goal: Fulfil verified export requests within a controlled process.
request.project_description: A user requests an export, verifies identity, and downloads a time-limited archive assembled from multiple services.

non_functional_requirements.text: The export process must complete within the legal service deadline.
Archive links must be single-user and time-limited.
Audit records must exclude archive content.

actors.description: The user who requests and downloads a personal data export.

actors.description: External service that verifies the user's identity.

actors.description: Service that sends the time-limited download notification.

use_cases.name: Request Personal Data Export
use_cases.goal: Allow a verified user to request an export of their personal data.
use_cases.trigger: The user initiates an export request.

success_postconditions.text: The export request is recorded and queued for processing.

failure_postconditions.text: The export request is rejected and no archive is created.

steps.action: The user requests an export of personal data.
steps.expected_result: The system receives the export request.

steps.action: The system requires recent identity verification.
steps.expected_result: The system checks that the user has recent identity verification.

steps.action: The system records the export request.
steps.expected_result: The export request is recorded and queued for processing.

steps.action: The system detects that recent identity verification is missing.
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the export request.

user_stories.capability: request an export of my personal data
user_stories.benefit: I can obtain a copy of my data

system_stories.responsibility: Ensure the user has recent identity verification before accepting the export request.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Request Personal Data Export
Goal: Allow a verified user to request an export of their personal data.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: The user initiates an export request.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: The user is authenticated.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] The user requests an export of personal data.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] The system requires recent identity verification.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] The system records the export request.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: Identity Verification Missing
Source FRs: FR-001, FR-002

use_cases.name: Assemble and Deliver Export Archive
use_cases.goal: Collect data from source services, create an encrypted archive, and notify the user for download.
use_cases.trigger: An export request is queued for processing.

preconditions.text: An export request has been recorded and queued.

success_postconditions.text: An encrypted archive is created and a time-limited download notification is sent.

failure_postconditions.text: The archive is not created and the user is notified of the failure.

steps.action: The system collects data from registered source services.
steps.expected_result: Data is collected from available source services.

steps.action: The system records unavailable sources without silently omitting them.
steps.expected_result: Unavailable sources are recorded in the export manifest.

steps.action: The system creates an encrypted archive.
The system sends a time-limited download notification.
steps.expected_result: The user receives a notification with a time-limited download link.
The system records the unavailable source without silently omitting it.

user_stories.capability: receive a time-limited download notification for my export archive
user_stories.benefit: I can download my data within a controlled time window

system_stories.system_action: Collect data from registered source services
system_stories.responsibility: Gather personal data from all registered source services.
Record any source services that are unavailable without silently omitting them.
Assemble collected data into an encrypted archive.
Notify the user with a time-limited download link.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Assemble and Deliver Export Archive
Goal: Collect data from source services, create an encrypted archive, and notify the user for download.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: An export request is queued for processing.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: An export request has been recorded and queued.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] The system collects data from registered source services.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] The system records unavailable sources without silently omitting them.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] The system creates an encrypted archive.
  4. [STEP-UC002-004] The system sends a time-limited download notification.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: Source Service Unavailable
Source FRs: FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006

use_cases.name: Download Export Archive
use_cases.goal: Allow the user to download the export archive after re-authentication.
use_cases.trigger: The user follows the time-limited download link.

preconditions.text: The user has received a time-limited download notification.

failure_postconditions.text: The download fails and the user is informed.

steps.action: The user downloads the archive after re-authentication.
steps.expected_result: The user successfully downloads the archive.

user_stories.capability: download my export archive after re-authentication
user_stories.benefit: I can securely obtain my data

system_stories.responsibility: Ensure the user re-authenticates before allowing the archive download.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Download Export Archive
Goal: Allow the user to download the export archive after re-authentication.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: The user follows the time-limited download link.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: The user has received a time-limited download notification.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] The user downloads the archive after re-authentication.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC003-EXC-001: Re-authentication Fails
Source FRs: FR-007

use_cases.name: Delete Expired Archive
use_cases.goal: Delete the export archive after its expiry.
use_cases.trigger: The archive reaches its expiry time.

preconditions.text: An encrypted archive exists and has an expiry time.

failure_postconditions.text: The archive is not deleted and an error is logged.

steps.action: The archive is deleted after expiry.
steps.expected_result: The archive is removed from storage.

user_stories.capability: have my export archive deleted after expiry
user_stories.benefit: my data is not retained longer than necessary

system_stories.responsibility: Remove the encrypted archive from storage after its expiry time.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-004 — Delete Expired Archive
Goal: Delete the export archive after its expiry.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: The archive reaches its expiry time.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC004-001: An encrypted archive exists and has an expiry time.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC004-001] The archive is deleted after expiry.
Source FRs: FR-008
